static_traits.name: Wang Peiqi
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but has not yet discussed these specific thoughts with them; relationships with potential partners affected by self-esteem issues; Work performance not yet affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar problems in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous at first consultation; Positive attitude, highly cooperative; clear expression, good logic; capable of self-awareness and Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: I believe others think I am not pretty, which affects my self-esteem and confidence, especially in the process of finding a marriage partner; I often experience Self-doubt and feel unattractive, mainly in social or first-meeting situations.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I am willing to do anything to make myself feel better and boost my confidence.'

special_situations.event: When in social settings or meeting strangers for the first time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not pretty enough in appearance, others will not want to talk with me or develop a relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Enhances confidence through makeup and styling; over-invests in appearance management before going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: People here probably all think I am not good-looking and do not want to talk with me

special_situations.event: The phase of actively looking for a marriage partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others judge me by appearance and think I am not pretty, I will be unable to find a partner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Enhancing appearance grooming before dates or meeting new friends; avoiding revealing these thoughts to friends to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will judge me by my appearance and think I am not pretty enough

special_situations.event: At gatherings or in public, notices she receives less attention compared with others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I receive little attention, it proves I am not pretty and not as good as others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-criticism and invests further in appearance grooming to 'catch up' with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others in looks

special_situations.event: During interactions with a potential partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not pretty enough, I will not be chosen as a partner and may be rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-preparing appearance before interactions; being cautious in social settings, reducing proactive expression to avoid Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He probably will not be interested in me because I am not good-looking

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and appreciated and to build a stable intimate relationship with a partner
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and rejected for appearance, experiencing shame and the pain of not being chosen
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected through excessive appearance grooming
Avoids revealing true thoughts to friends to reduce the possibility of being judged
Staying cautious and Self-monitoring in social settings to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: Feeling inferior, a self that needs to gain recognition through appearance
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially potential partners) are experienced as harsh judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite her to share shameful thoughts related to appearance, or when she feels watched and compared in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously viewing others as judges, believing they will find oneself shallow or not good-looking (transference: others = critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a gentle, accepting tone, first Empathize with her shame and worries, then use open-ended questions to guide her to specify evidence and experiences; avoid judgment and excessive Interpretation, keep a slow pace and build a sense of safety.

manifestations: Strongly desiring to find a marriage partner to counter the sense of Loneliness
Worries about being judged by appearance in social settings and initiates conversation less
Not revealing true thoughts to friends out of shame
outcomes: Excessive investment in appearance and time spent

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Constantly experiencing Self-doubt and second-guessing in Social situations
Admitting nervousness in sessions, expressing cautiously
Spending excessive time on grooming before going out to ensure being 'up to standard'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Interpreting others' gazes or insufficient attention as 'they think I am not pretty'
On first meeting, assumes others will negatively evaluate his appearance

positive_force: Willing to seek help and actively cooperate with counseling, strong motivation
Has a supportive network of friends(has several close friends)
Stable work performance; daily functioning maintained
Able to notice and begin questioning negative automatic thoughts (acknowledges the lack of evidence and sees contrary evidence)
negative_force: Frequent mind reading and jumping to conclusions, excessive concern with others' evaluations
Severe Self-monitoring and Self-doubt, relying on external validation
Over-invests in appearance management to seek temporary relief, causing time consumption
Shame and Fear of Being rejected affecting interactions with potential partners

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive grooming before and after social events (makeup and styling take a long time)
antecedent: When approaching social events or meeting strangers for the first time
Preparing to interact with a potential partner
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on the belief 'others think I am not pretty', using appearance grooming as compensation to ease Anxiety and insecurity
target_behavior.function: Seeking external validation, temporarily reducing the Fear of Being rejected
target_behavior.consequence: Disrupts daily routines, consumes time and energy, still hard to stably raise self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Showing significant Anxiety and Self-doubt in Social situations, reducing proactive communication
antecedent: Being in social settings or meeting new friends for the first time
Noticing that others pay little attention to oneself
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and jumping to conclusions, predicting that others will reject me because of my appearance and feeling ashamed
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection and shame, protecting self-esteem in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships with potential partners affected, missed interaction opportunities, Decreased sense of self-worth
